Dedicated team

From one dedicated developer with team-lead review to a full team in Tashkent, working on your product every day without you hiring an IT department. With Qilich, the basic plan costs UZS 36–55 mln per month; work starts within 1–2 weeks.

Start
1–2 weeks

UZS 36–55 mln $3,000–4,500

Who it is for
Startups, Banks, E-commerce, Telecom and internet providers, Any business
Integrations
  • Telegram

What you get

Basic plan
  • One full-time developer with code review by a team lead and QA support
  • Weekly plan and report
Extended plan
  • A team of 3–6 (developers, QA, designer, project manager)
  • Two-week sprints
  • Demos
  • Delivery metrics

Questions

How much does “Dedicated team” cost per month?
At Qilich the basic plan costs $3,000–4,500 (UZS 36–55 mln) per month, the extended plan $10,000–22,000 (UZS 120–265 mln) per month. The exact price depends on the scope of work.
How soon can “Dedicated team” start?
Qilich starts within 1–2 weeks.
What do we need to provide for “Dedicated team”?
The project's code and documents, access rights, a contact person.

Prefer to talk? Call +998 97 270 70 07 or send Qilich an enquiry.
